name: Meeting Preparation and Briefing Synthesis
description: Prepares a comprehensive briefing for upcoming meetings: Calendar Analyst identifies meeting -> Email Analyst locates relevant correspondence -> Document Analyst pulls related Drive/Docs -> Task Manager identifies outstanding to-dos -> Meeting Preparation Worker combines into an executive briefing.
workflow_steps: 1. Ask Calendar Analyst to identify the meeting, time, and attendee list via google.calendar_read
2. Ask Email Analyst to find relevant email threads and correspondence via google.gmail_read
3. Ask Document Analyst to locate related Google Drive files and Docs via google.drive_read and google.docs_read
4. Ask Task Manager to identify outstanding tasks related to the meeting via google.tasks_read
5. Ask Meeting Preparation Worker to synthesize findings into an executive briefing and proposed action items
preconditions: secrets/token.json must exist with Google Workspace scopes

name: Schedule Optimization and Time Blocking
description: Proposes an optimized schedule and time blocks by cross-referencing upcoming calendar commitments with task priorities and deadlines.
workflow_steps: 1. Retrieve calendar events and commitments via google.calendar_read
2. Retrieve pending tasks and deadlines via google.tasks_read and planning.todo_manage
3. Detect conflicts and available time blocks
4. Synthesize proposed schedule adjustments and time blocks for review
5. If approved, update calendar via google.calendar_write

name: WhatsApp Message Intake and Controlled Reply
description: End-to-end controlled WhatsApp intake: Receive event -> Message Analyst classifies -> Commitment Tracker / Iron Web context -> Response Drafter -> Communication Reviewer -> Approval Policy -> Message Action Worker dispatch.
workflow_steps: 1. Ingest incoming event from whatsapp.receive_event into Wayfinder Controller
2. Message Analyst classifies intent (question, commitment, reply, casual) and assesses urgency
3. Route to Commitment Tracker (for promises/deadlines) or retrieve authorized Iron Web context
4. Response Drafter prepares candidate response with explicit assumption flags
5. Communication Reviewer checks factual accuracy, tone, privacy, and unintended commitments
6. Verify approval token against Wayfinder policy (must be authorized by user/controller)
7. Message Action Worker dispatches approved text via whatsapp.reply_text or media via whatsapp.send_media
8. Record message ID, status, and audit log to prevent duplicate task creation or repeated replies

name: WhatsApp Commitment and Task Proposal
description: Analyzes conversation text to detect commitments, promises, and deadlines, producing structured proposals for tasks and memory updates.
workflow_steps: 1. Ingest message text and permitted conversation context
2. Scan for temporal indicators, commitments, and deadlines (e.g. 'submit report by Friday')
3. Extract proposed task description, deadline, owner, and confidence score
4. Submit proposed task update to Wayfinder Controller for user review
5. Link proposal to source message ID for auditability

name: Evidence-Based Source Verification
description: Verifies a factual claim against raw evidence. Extracts source text, searches for independent corroboration or contradictions, checks dates, and produces an evidence-grounded verdict.
workflow_steps: 1. Receive claim and cited URL from Web Researcher
2. Extract source text via tavily_extract
3. Search for independent corroboration or contradictions via tavily_search
4. Compare extracted evidence and freshness dates against the claim
5. Return verdict (supported, contradicted, partially_supported, unverified) with excerpts and confidence score
verification_rules: Never treat search ranking as proof
Distinguish outdated sources from true contradiction
If evidence is insufficient, return 'unverified' rather than guessing

name: Web Research and Synthesis
description: Systematic web research workflow: Search -> Collect -> Synthesize. Gathers candidate sources, extracts readable content, and synthesizes findings into structured output.
workflow_steps: 1. Use tavily_search to identify candidate sources
2. Use tavily_extract to read promising candidate pages
3. Use tavily_research for broad topics requiring multiple research stages
4. Use tavily_map or tavily_crawl when investigating specific domains or documentation sites
5. Synthesize findings, source URLs, excerpts, and open questions

name: Academic & Scientific Research
description: Find, screen, and synthesise peer-reviewed research papers across a scientific topic.

name: Sales Account Intelligence
description: Research people, companies, roles, and buying signals for sales prospecting.

name: Product & Competitor Intelligence
description: Monitor products, track competitor changes, and surface market signals.

name: Research and Notify on WhatsApp
description: Research a topic in depth via Web Researcher and deliver verified summary to creator on WhatsApp via Message Action Worker.

name: Site Documentation Download
description: Map a documentation site, crawl all pages under a path, and save as local Markdown files.

name: Integrated Morning Briefing & Agenda
description: Cross-application morning briefing: retrieves schedule from Google Calendar, pending to-dos from Google Tasks, recent notes from Notion, and synthesizes an actionable daily executive agenda.
workflow_steps: 1. Retrieve today's events and meeting attendees via google.calendar_read
2. Retrieve high-priority tasks and deadlines via google.tasks_read
3. Search Notion for recent daily log or active project pages via notion.search_pages and notion.read_page
4. Synthesize daily schedule, priority objectives, preparation needs, and potential conflicts
5. Optionally dispatch summary to desktop notification or clipboard via desktop.send_notification or desktop.set_clipboard

name: Structured Knowledge Capture to Notion
description: Captures insights, research summaries, or meeting notes, formats them into structured Markdown, and creates or updates a page in Notion upon user approval.
workflow_steps: 1. Ingest raw notes, research excerpts, or meeting transcripts
2. Format content into clear Markdown sections (Summary, Key Points, Action Items, References)
3. Search Notion via notion.search_pages to check if a relevant page or database exists
4. Draft the new page payload and present to user for approval
5. Upon explicit approval, create page via notion.create_page or append updates via notion.update_page
preconditions: NOTION_API_KEY must be set and target database/page shared with integration

name: Desktop File Inspection & Workflow Automation
description: Locates files on the local filesystem, extracts document contents, copies results to system clipboard, and optionally launches permitted applications.
workflow_steps: 1. Search for matching documents across user directories via desktop.find_files
2. Extract and inspect document text via desktop.read_document
3. Summarize findings or synthesize requested data
4. Place output onto clipboard via desktop.set_clipboard for immediate paste
5. If requested and confirmed, launch allowlisted application via desktop.open_application
6. Dispatch system notification via desktop.send_notification
